Cover Letter

Dear Chris,

Thank you for the opportunity to quote five travel trailers for your 12-month requirement in San Diego. Yuma RV Rentals will deliver all five units by October 26, 2026 and support them for the full rental term with 24/7 telephone troubleshooting and on-site technicians.

This quote follows your Scope of Work in order. Section 2 covers the proposed units and specifications, Section 3 covers maintenance, response times, and replacement units, Section 4 gives the fixed price with per-unit monthly and annual detail, and Section 5 sets out responsibilities for utilities, propane, wastewater, damage, insurance, and site access.

All mandatory service calls and technician dispatches are included in the monthly rate, and we confirm availability of all five units for the complete 12-month rental period. We also offer a 10 percent discount on the monthly rate for six months paid in advance, and 15 percent for twelve months paid in advance.

We are glad to walk through any part of this quote and to coordinate the delivery schedule with your site.

Sincerely,

Yuma RV Rentals LLC

Yuma RV Rentals will deliver, set up, maintain, and remove five fully equipped travel trailers for a 12-month rental in San Diego. Each trailer sleeps up to four, has a roof-mounted air conditioner, a furnace, an on-demand water heater, and lockable exterior storage. Maintenance, 24/7 technical support, and every required service call are included in one fixed price.

3Maintenance and Technical Support

Every trailer is covered for the full 12-month term. All mandatory service calls and technician dispatches are included in the fixed price, with no per-call charges.

Coverage

  • 24/7 telephone troubleshooting with a qualified RV technician.
  • On-site technical maintenance throughout the rental term.
  • Technician dispatched to the trailer whenever an issue cannot be resolved by phone.
  • Parts and labor for repairs from normal use, including air conditioning, furnace, water heater, plumbing, electrical, appliances, slide-outs, and awnings.

Response times

ServiceResponse
Telephone troubleshootingAnswered or returned within 30 minutes, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
On-site technicianAt the trailer within 24 hours when an issue cannot be resolved by phone
Urgent issuesLoss of power, water, air conditioning, or heat, and any safety issue, are prioritized for same-day dispatch
Replacement unitDelivered within 48 hours if a trailer cannot be returned to service

Repair process

  1. The occupant or site contact calls the 24/7 support line.
  2. A technician troubleshoots the issue by phone and resolves it remotely where possible.
  3. If it cannot be resolved remotely, a technician is dispatched to the trailer.
  4. The technician completes the repair on site, with parts and labor included.
  5. If the trailer cannot be returned to service within 48 hours, a comparable replacement trailer is delivered and set up at no additional charge.

5Responsibilities

The Scope of Work asked that these items be identified separately. Each is assigned below.

ItemResponsible partyHow it works
Delivery and setupYuma RV RentalsPriced in Section 4. We deliver, level, and stabilize each trailer, connect it to the utilities at the site, and confirm every system works before handover.
Pickup at end of termYuma RV RentalsIncluded in the price. We disconnect, inspect, and remove each trailer.
UtilitiesCustomer (site)The site provides electrical service, potable water, and a sewer connection at each trailer location. We make all connections to the trailers.
Propane replenishmentCustomer, or Yuma RV Rentals on requestEach trailer is delivered with both 30 lb tanks full. Refills are available at the as-needed rate in Section 4.
Wastewater servicingCustomer, or Yuma RV Rentals on requestWhere a sewer connection is not available, tank pump-out is available at the as-needed rate in Section 4.
DamageCustomer, for damage beyond normal wearNormal wear and all mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and appliance failures are repaired at no charge under the maintenance coverage.
InsuranceYuma RV Rentals for the trailers; Customer for occupants and their belongingsA certificate of insurance is available on request.
Site accessCustomerThe customer provides access to each trailer location for delivery, service visits, and pickup.
